items.title: HCI Group (HCI) Could Be 22% Below Fair Value As Credit Facility Expands
items.summary: HCI Group (HCI) recently entered a new unsecured revolving credit facility of up to US$300 million with Fifth Third Bank, replacing a prior US$150 million line and extending access to funding through 2031. Recent trading tells a mixed story. The share price is up 3.15% year to date and the 1-year total shareholder return is 9.05%. However, momentum has cooled with a 7.04% decline in the 30-day share price, even as HCI Group secures this larger credit line and reports a 3-year total...

items.title: 3 Regional Bank Stocks For Higher Rates In The US
items.summary: When a Federal Reserve official talks about “soon” rate hikes and a higher path for borrowing costs through 2027, the ripple effects can reshape which stocks quietly gain an edge. Rising real yields can reward some balance sheets while putting others under strain, so sitting on the sidelines can mean missing that shift. This article breaks down three large-cap U.S. financial stocks exposed to this rate story and explains how the same macro shock can create very different setups for...
